# gravitee_application (Resource)

An APIM application. Its `client_id` is what the gateway matches against the token when the API's OAuth2 plan runs with `modeStrict` enabled.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gravitee_application" "partner" {
  name        = "partner-app"
  description = "Client used by an external partner"

  # Must match the client_id of the Keycloak client when the API's OAuth2
  # plan runs with modeStrict enabled.
  client_id = "partner-app"

  groups = ["00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Required by the API: `UpdateApplicationEntity` demands `description`.
- `name` (String) Application name.

### Optional

- `app_type` (String) `settings.app.type`. Defaults to `web`.
- `client_id` (String) `settings.app.client_id`. Must match the `client_id` of the client in your identity provider. If omitted, the server generates one.
- `groups` (Set of String) UUIDs of the groups that own the application. If omitted, the server assigns a default group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID assigned by the server.
- `status` (String) Computed by the server, for example `ACTIVE`.
- `type` (String) Internal type computed by the server, for example `SIMPLE`.
